summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend for paintings with admin-only CRUD, plus a new frontend gallery/admin app with Internet Identity-based access guard, a mailto contact CTA component, header/footer branding, and a dark theme. Some requested public email-display requirements are not clearly met in the listing cards/detail views based on the provided diff summary. Several non-requested user-profile/account-related backend features were added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Show the contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" on all public painting listing pages and painting detail pages, including a clear mailto: link CTA.
missing_requirements.reason: Painting listing card component shown in the diff does not display the email address or a mailto link, and the painting detail page implementation is not included in the diff summary to verify it meets the requirement.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/PaintingDetailPage (added but not shown in diff summary)

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a mission statement section on the public site stating that proceeds support building and developing affordable modern housing for the local community.
missing_requirements.reason: A MissionStatement component is added, but the diff summary does not show it being rendered on any public page (e.g., GalleryPage), so visibility on the public site cannot be confirmed.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage (added but not shown in diff summary)

hallucinated_features.description: User profile data model and profile query/update methods (getCallerUserProfile, getUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) with user permissions.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists user accounts/profiles as out of scope (non-goals), but backend introduces userProfiles state and related public methods.

hallucinated_features.description: Initialization of access control via a secret URL parameter "caffeineAdminToken" and calling a backend method _initializeAccessControlWithSecret.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires Internet Identity auth and admin-identity restriction, but does not request or describe a secret-token URL parameter flow for access control initialization.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes a promotional link to caffeine.ai with tracking parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.
